beats.visual: real pixel colours fly in and assemble the photo; title rises
camera pushes into the nose; the real 8-bit RGB values of a 6x6 patch appear over the pixels
beats.say: To a neural network, this photo is a grid of numbers.
beats.caption: To a neural network, this photo is a grid of numbers.

beats.visual: camera pulls out; the photo splits into its red, green and blue planes, which slide apart in depth
beats.caption: 224 by 224 pixels, 3 colours each: 150,528 numbers.

beats.visual: the 64 real filters pop in as a grid, tile by tile; three that respond most lift out
beats.say: Its first layer has 64 small filters, learned from ImageNet.
beats.caption: Its first layer has 64 small filters, learned from ImageNet.

beats.visual: one filter sweeps the photo row by row while its feature map paints itself beside it
beats.say: Each filter slides across the image and lights up where its pattern appears.
beats.caption: Each filter slides across the image and lights up where its pattern appears.

beats.visual: the three filters each drop onto their own map
beats.caption: Three of the 64 maps.

beats.visual: five fanned stacks of real channel maps, shrinking; particles stream through them; the camera tracks right
beats.say: Layer after layer, the maps get smaller and more numerous: from 64 maps of 112 by 112 to 512 maps of 7 by 7.
beats.caption: Layer after layer, the maps get smaller and more numerous: from 64 maps of 112 by 112 to 512 maps of 7 by 7.

beats.visual: the last stack collapses into a barcode of the 512 real pooled values
beats.say: The 512 maps are averaged into 512 numbers.
beats.caption: The 512 maps are averaged into 512 numbers.

beats.visual: the barcode streams into five probability bars that grow; the top one counts up to its value
beats.say: Those become a score for each of 1,000 classes. Golden retriever: 73.5%.
beats.caption: Those become a score for each of 1,000 classes. Golden retriever: 73.5%.

beats.visual: the photo returns; a heat map washes over it from left to right
beats.say: Where is that answer most sensitive? Here.
beats.caption: Where is that answer most sensitive? Here.

beats.visual: two photo cards fly in and flip to show their labels
beats.say: Other photos: goldfish, 98.4%. A tabby it calls Egyptian cat, 35.5%.
beats.caption: Other photos: goldfish, 98.4%. A tabby it calls Egyptian cat, 35.5%.

beats.visual: a third card lands; its label is struck in red
beats.say: And sometimes it is wrong: this cat is a mousetrap, 49.1%.
beats.caption: And sometimes it is wrong: this cat is a mousetrap, 49.1%.

beats.visual: a shimmering change pattern (shown 64 times stronger) slides onto the photo
beats.say: Now change every pixel value by at most 2 out of 255.
beats.caption: Now change every pixel value by at most 2 out of 255.

beats.visual: before and after side by side; a slider wipes between them
beats.say: To us, the photo looks the same.
beats.caption: To us, the photo looks the same.

beats.visual: the bars from before re-sort: golden retriever drains, goldfish shoots to the top
beats.say: To the network, it is now a goldfish, with more than 99.99%.
beats.caption: To the network, it is now a goldfish, with more than 99.99%.

beats.visual: the caveat tags settle under the result
beats.say: One model, one photo, an attacker who knows the weights. Still: 2 out of 255 was enough.
beats.caption: One model, one photo, an attacker who knows the weights. Still: 2 out of 255 was enough.
